content: script.module.clouddrive.common (cguZZman) is licensed GPL-3.0-or-later, identical to plugin.onedrive, so copying its source into this repo is licence-compatible with no relicensing and no compatibility analysis needed - only attribution obligations (retain copyright headers, keep LICENSE.txt, state modifications). Its nested clouddrive/common/cache/LICENSE (11.5 KB) indicates cache.py is itself third-party vendored code under a separate permissive licence whose text must be preserved verbatim if that file is kept. Its addon.xml also declares script.module.dateutil and script.module.pyqrcode dependencies, which are separate Kodi modules with their own licences.
